change.description: Keep strict Playbook metadata validation for new sources while allowing the deployed-edition reader to remove historical internal doc metadata before validation during release recovery.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The compatibility path is opt-in and limited to historical deployed catalog reads. New source validation, public payload shape, release identity, and persistent application state remain unchanged.

current.reasoning: The release bridge carries the current schema, bundle reader, retained-artifact reader, cache validator, and deployed-edition preparation script into the freeze step, where only the deployed pointer path enables internal metadata stripping. Historical catalog bytes retain their published identity while malformed metadata and all ordinary source reads remain rejected.

scope_drift.description: The change remains limited to historical deployed Playbook metadata compatibility and the recovery workflow tooling bridge.

verified.reasoning: The focused Playbook contract, compatibility, release identity, and workflow tests pass. Strict default validation still rejects internal metadata, while the explicit deployed-read option strips only recognized internal doc metadata before validation and preserves historical file identity through download, cache adoption, restart, and publication.
